title: It's Time: The Christmas Switch
trend: TikTok 'It's Time' holiday-season kickoff (festive setups unveiled to the famous 'it's time' holiday audio; #1 on New Engen's TikTok list updated Nov 5 2026, US) + 'The Christmas Switch' (feeds flipping from fall to holiday decor in early November; SocialPilot Nov 2026 list, US) — Gloria declares 'it's time' and starts turning the living room into Christmas, Frank defends Thanksgiving, the porch pumpkin refuses to retire and the inflatable snowman keeps deflating; twist: Frank has had a full Christmas garage since August
length_reason: The original 'it's time' kickoff clips are one quick reveal of fifteen to thirty seconds, so this stays a quick one-clip skit at the short end (180 s, which also fits Instagram's three-minute limit).
youtube_title: It's Time: The Great Christmas Switch | Funny Family Cartoon
description:
Gloria has waited all year to say two words: it's time. Frank says Thanksgiving comes first. The porch pumpkin refuses to retire, and the snowman keeps losing air.

#cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #christmas
tiktok_caption: she waited all year to say it. it's time. #cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #christmas

lines.text: Frank. Put down the turkey flyer. It's time.
It is not time. It is November eleventh. That is fall.
I have waited three hundred and twenty days. My body is a calendar.
We have a deal. No Christmas until the turkey is gone.
The turkey is fine. The turkey can watch.
The turkey can't watch. It's in the freezer. It's frozen and upset.
Then it will be cold and festive. Like me.
Step one. The wreath goes on the door.
There is already a wreath on the door. It is made of corn.
The corn wreath has had a good run. It can retire to the garage.
Do not send anything to the garage.
Why not?
The garage is full. Of feelings. And a lawn mower.
Excuse me. Nobody is retiring anybody.
Oh no. The porch pumpkin is awake.
I have been on that porch since September. I have seniority.
You are leaning. You are soft on one side.
That is called character. I have seen two frosts and a raccoon.
Thank you. The pumpkin understands Thanksgiving.
I do not understand it. I fear it. Thanksgiving is when they make the pie.
Step two. The lights.
Last year you put up so many lights the airplanes waved.
One airplane. And it was a very nice pilot.
Step three. Blizzard. Wake up, buddy.
Hi! Hello! Is it time? It's time! I can feel the air!
Who plugged in the snowman?
He plugs himself in. He has a lot of drive.
I have been folded in a box since January. I am so happy. I am so round.
You are a bag with a fan in it.
And you are a vegetable with a porch. We all have stuff.
He is twelve feet tall. The neighbors will think we gave up on fall.
Oh no. I'm losing air. I get nervous and I lose air.
I'm on the lawn now. I live on the lawn. This is my life.
Gloria, I just want one holiday at a time. Like a normal person.
Fine. Fine! I'll put the extra tree in the garage until the turkey is gone.
No! Not the garage.
Interesting.
Frank. What is in the garage?
I can see the garage from the porch. It has been blinking since August.
Since August?
Okay. There may be a small tree.
Two trees. A train. A sleigh made of lawn chairs.
The sleigh is not finished. Do not judge the sleigh.
You made me wait three hundred and twenty days!
I needed one place where it was already time.
I go out there to get the lawn mower. I sit in the sleigh. I eat a cookie.
That is the most beautiful thing you have ever said.
Can I live in the garage? It sounds warm. I'm still deflating.
There is an outlet by the sleigh. You can have it.
Best day of my life! I'm round again!
It's time. But the turkey still gets Thursday.
And what happens to me?
You can stay. We'll give you a little scarf. You'll be a Christmas pumpkin.
A Christmas pumpkin. Nobody makes pie in December.
Actually, Gloria makes a Christmas pumpkin pie.
Raccoon. It's time.
